title: Turn your SkillCorner data into insights on Marquee
markdown:
[![](https://themarquee.ai/icons/arrow-small-left.svg)Back](https://themarquee.ai/)

![SkillCorner × Marquee partnership](https://themarquee.ai/news/skillcorner-partnership.png)

[SkillCorner](https://skillcorner.com/) users can now access their Physical and Game Intelligence data via the Marquee platform, where Marquee combines their unique tracking-derived metrics with event, financial, and injury data from other providers, giving clubs decision-ready insights on any player or team, in seconds instead of weeks.

Tracking data tells you what happened on the pitch. The hard part is knowing what to do about it. Inside Marquee, clubs can put their SkillCorner Physical and Game Intelligence metrics to work across every Player 360 scout report, Discovery query and opponent analysis, each shaped by their club’s sporting DNA and drawing on everything else the platform unifies.

“SkillCorner’s reputation speaks for itself. We’re here to empower our clients to make the best of their Physical and Game Intelligence data,” said Dean Bracha, Co-Founder and CEO of Marquee.

Both companies are building for the same clubs and the same goal: better football decisions, reached faster.

## About Marquee

Marquee turns football data into decision-ready insights in seconds, unifying external and internal data and filtering it through each club’s sporting DNA. Professional clubs use Marquee for recruitment, squad planning and analytics. Learn more at [themarquee.ai](https://themarquee.ai/).

![](https://themarquee.ai/illustrations/cta-visual-before.svg)![](https://themarquee.ai/illustrations/cta-visual.svg)

## See what your data has been hiding.

See Marquee run on your club, not someone else's.
